info.name: Gong Auditing Audit Logs Flows API

params.name: flowOwnerEmail
params.description: Filter flows by the owner's email address.

params.name: cursor
params.description: A cursor for pagination. Pass the cursor from the previous response to retrieve the next page of results.

items.docs: Retrieves a list of all available Engage flows. Results can be filtered by flow owner email and workspace, and are paginated.

params.name: flowId
params.description: The unique identifier of the Engage flow.

items.docs: Overrides the content of specific steps in an Engage flow to tailor messaging for specific campaigns or workflows. Allows customizing email subjects, bodies, and other step content.
